context: As a result, it is tempting to make a clean sweep and argue that “democratic” means nothing of any importance.
meaning: 全盘否定、一概抹掉
current_zh: 人们很容易把这个词一笔勾销
suggest: 一笔勾销
note: 现译已贴切，中性

context: Parliament was a “talking shop”, a decorative façade for the “dictatorship of the bourgeoisie”.
meaning: 列宁用语：只空谈、不办事的议会；贬义
current_zh: 议会不过是一个“清谈馆”
suggest: 清谈馆
note: 列宁《国家与革命》通行中译作“清谈馆”，本章 p.187（列宁引文）、p.197 同用，保持统一

context: Parliament was a “talking shop”, a decorative façade for the “dictatorship of the bourgeoisie”.
meaning: 装饰门面的摆设，掩盖真实统治；贬义
current_zh: 是“资产阶级专政”的装饰性门面
suggest: 是给“资产阶级专政”装点门面的
note: “装点门面”现成贴切；“遮羞布”贬义过重，不用；p.197 同一比喻宜同译

context: Real power was exercised behind the scenes in the offices of the State and the boardrooms of great companies.
meaning: 在公众看不见的地方
current_zh: 真正的权力运作发生在幕后
suggest: 真正的权力在幕后运作
note: 现成说法，只需去掉“运作发生在”的翻译腔

context: This is the ultimate line of defence of the ruling class and its answer to the “irreconcilable class antagonisms”.
meaning: 统治阶级最后的保障
current_zh: 这就是统治阶级最后一道防线
suggest: 最后一道防线
note: 中英比喻一致，保留

context: Gradually, the balance of class power could be shifted by successive waves of reforms without open violence of civil war
meaning: 一轮接一轮的改革
current_zh: 通过一波又一波改革
suggest: 一波接一波的改革
note: 保留即可

context: The State was not a machine, depending for its direction on whoever sat in the driving seat.
meaning: 谁掌控国家，国家就听谁的
current_zh: 国家不是一台机器，不是说谁坐进驾驶位它就会按谁的意志行驶。
suggest: 国家不是一台谁坐上驾驶座就听谁使唤的机器
note: 作者在说理，比喻要保留并顺一顺句子；前一句 different directors 现译作“掌舵者”，换成了船的比喻，与此处机器/驾驶座不统一，宜改“主事的人”

en: the existing State colonized the socialists
context: Adding a few socialists to the existing State was not a method of changing its direction; it was a method by which the existing State colonized the socialists.
meaning: 现存国家反过来把社会主义者占领、改造成自己的人
current_zh: 而只是现成国家把社会主义者吞进去的一种办法
suggest: 而是现存国家收编社会主义者的办法
note: colonize 是占领并改造；“收编”贴切；“招安”带中国古代画面而场景在欧洲，不用；p.191 同一比喻宜同译

context: The only possibility of a real revolution came, not through endeavouring to redirect the existing State, but, in the words of Marx, Engels and Lenin, smashing it.
meaning: 马克思主义经典用语：彻底摧毁旧国家机器
current_zh: 而在于用马克思、恩格斯和列宁的话说，把它砸碎
suggest: 打碎
note: 《国家与革命》等中译通行“打碎旧的国家机器”；本章 p.195 “smash” 现译也作“砸碎”，两处统一即可

en: rooted ... in the workers’ control of production
context: keeping working-class institutions firmly independent of the existing State and rooted, not in the existing army and police, but in the workers’ control of production
meaning: 以工人对生产的控制为根基
current_zh: 扎根于工人对生产及其剩余的控制，而非依靠现存军队和警察
suggest: 扎根于
note: 中英比喻一致，保留

context: On this question, Engels’ logic was implacable:
meaning: 恩格斯的推理毫不留情、不容妥协
current_zh: 恩格斯在这个问题上的逻辑十分彻底
suggest: 恩格斯在这个问题上毫不含糊
note: implacable 有冷酷、不容通融之意，“彻底”偏弱；“斩钉截铁”贴切但偏指语气

en: dragged into the light of public discussion
context: The exercise of power had to be dragged into the light of public discussion
meaning: 强行把权力运作公开，接受公众讨论
current_zh: 权力运作必须被拖到公众讨论的光亮之中
suggest: 权力运作必须摆到光天化日之下，交给公众讨论
note: “光天化日之下”本身中性；dragged 有被迫义，“摆到”稍弱，必要时作“硬拉到”

en: The tight hold of civil war closed in on the infant republic, threatening to strangle Moscow.
context: The moment was brief. The tight hold of civil war closed in on the infant republic, threatening to strangle Moscow.
meaning: 内战像绞索一样收紧，新生的共和国连同莫斯科都有被扼杀的危险
current_zh: 内战所形成的窒息性压力很快压向这个新生共和国，使其几乎无法喘息。
suggest: 内战的绞索向襁褓中的共和国步步收紧，眼看就要勒住莫斯科
alt: 内战的包围圈越收越紧
note: 现译丢了 Moscow，strangle 也弱化为“无法喘息”；“襁褓中”对应 infant

context: with a special commissar attached to watch their every move
meaning: 严密监视其一切行动
current_zh: 同时还得派专门政委贴身监督其一举一动
suggest: 一举一动
note: 现译贴切，保留

en: succumbed, and were colonized by the commanders
context: The political commissars appointed to represent the supervision of the working class over the commanders in due course succumbed, and were colonized by the commanders.
meaning: 政委抵挡不住，反被指挥员一方同化吸收
current_zh: 原本代表工人阶级对指挥员实行监督的政治委员，最终也被同化，成为指挥员体制的一部分。
suggest: 最终也败下阵来，被指挥员收编了
note: 与 p.188 colonized 同一比喻，宜同译“收编”；现译没有体现 succumbed

context: “The hail-fellow-well-met spirit in the relationships between a commander and a subordinate can have no place in the Red Army.”
meaning: 上下级之间亲热随便、不讲礼数的作风
current_zh: 一位将军说，红军上下级之间不容有称兄道弟、不拘礼数的风气
suggest: 称兄道弟
note: 引文出自苏联将领（经英译转引），非中文原始文献，可用中文成语；现译已贴切

context: Indeed, even friendliness between men and officers was frowned upon.
meaning: 被视为不妥、不受欢迎
current_zh: 甚至连军官与士兵的亲近往来也受到反对。
suggest: 甚至官兵之间稍显亲近，都会招来白眼
note: frown upon 是皱眉不以为然，比“反对”轻；“招来白眼”口语，可视上下文改用备选

en: only one symptom of social change
context: The transformation of the “armed bodies of men” was only one symptom of social change in Russia.
meaning: 俄国社会变化的一个外在表现
current_zh: 苏联“武装队伍”的改变，只是更大社会变化中的一个征候。
suggest: 只是俄国社会变化的一个表征
note: “征候”可用；顺便补回 in Russia

context: When he anathematized “bureaucracy” he was not attacking the State of which he stood at the apex.
meaning: 严厉谴责，原义为教会诅咒、革出教门
current_zh: 当他诅咒“官僚主义”时
suggest: 他痛斥“官僚主义”时
note: “诅咒”太字面，中文语境像骂街；“痛斥/大加挞伐”力度相当

en: the State of which he stood at the apex
context: When he anathematized “bureaucracy” he was not attacking the State of which he stood at the apex.
meaning: 他本人身居顶端的国家
current_zh: 他攻击的并不是自己所处其顶端的那个国家
suggest: 他自己高踞顶端的那个国家
note: 现译“所处其顶端”拗口

context: but the democratic’ instrument of—what for Marx and Lenin was a contradiction in terms—a “classless State” of the “People”.
meaning: 概念本身自相矛盾
current_zh: 而这在马克思和列宁那里，本来根本就是自相矛盾的说法。
suggest: 自相矛盾
note: 现成对应；现译“本来根本就是”冗余

context: If democratic control actually existed, it would be unnecessary to deliver such homilies
meaning: 发表道德训诫，原义为布道；略带贬义
current_zh: 就不必再作这些说教
suggest: 说教
note: “说教”贴切；不用“耳提面命”，那带长辈恳切的褒义

context: Perhaps, in the heady days of 1966, he was persuaded to adopt the electoral principle
meaning: 1966 年那段令人兴奋、热烈的日子
current_zh: 也许在 1966 年那个头脑发热的时刻
suggest: 也许在 1966 年那段热火朝天的日子里
note: heady 指令人兴奋陶醉，不等于“头脑发热”；现译多出“鲁莽冲动”的贬义判断，且像是在说毛本人

context: But perhaps Mao’s conception of democracy is not borne out in practice? Perhaps the actual institutional structure of modern China goes much further than the Chairman was prepared to put into words.
meaning: 实践未必与毛的民主观一致（作者假设实践可能比毛说的更民主）
current_zh: 不过，毛的民主观也许并不符合实际？
suggest: 不过，也许实际情形和毛的民主观并不一样？
note: 现译“不符合实际”容易读成“毛的观点错了”，与下一句“实际制度走得更远”衔接不上

en: invested with no more than a puppet’s life
context: It was invented by the new government under the electoral law of March 1953, and invested with no more than a puppet’s life.
meaning: 从一开始就只是傀儡；贬义
current_zh: 从一开始就只是个提线木偶
suggest: 生来就只是个傀儡
note: 两种说法都可，力度相当

context: The Soviet had to be emasculated by the party leadership.
meaning: 被剥夺实权，原义阉割；作者用词尖刻
current_zh: 苏维埃还必须由党的领导层加以阉割
suggest: 阉割
note: “架空”更自然，但丢了原词的狠劲；作者语气尖刻，保留“阉割”亦可

en: the decimation of much of the government
context: the removal of the Head of State (Liu Shaoqi) and the Defence Minister (Lin Biao), and the decimation of much of the government.
meaning: 政府大批成员被清除
current_zh: 以及政府大部遭到清洗
suggest: 以及政府大半人马被清洗
note: decimation 原指十抽一处决，今泛指大批损毁；“清洗”可用；“一空”略夸张

en: the decorative façade of the State
context: The NPC is part of the decorative façade of the State; indeed, it is more an empty “talking shop” than those parliaments in Western countries criticized by Lenin.
meaning: 国家用来装点门面的摆设
current_zh: 全国人大只是国家门面的组成部分。
suggest: 全国人大不过是国家装点门面的摆设
note: 现译丢了 decorative；与 p.187 同一比喻宜同译；“花瓶”口语俏皮，看上下文

context: he promised it would be reorganized from the top so that the party old guard would not dominate it
meaning: 党内的老一辈、守旧元老
current_zh: 使党的老干部不再占主导
suggest: 党内元老
note: old guard 原指拿破仑老近卫军，转指守旧老派；“老干部”可用，“元老”更贴近

en: without a semblance of democratic legitimacy
context: an entirely new body, the Cultural Revolution Group, was created, without a semblance of democratic legitimacy
meaning: 连民主合法性的表面样子都没有
current_zh: 于是又另设了一个完全没有任何民主正当性的机构
suggest: 连一点民主合法性的影子都没有
note: semblance 是“外表、样子”，“影子”贴切

context: In the final analysis, only Mao himself represented the majority
meaning: 归根到底
current_zh: 从最终意义上说
suggest: 归根结底
note: 现译是翻译腔

context: All such bodies were “transmission belts”, not for the controlling power of the majority over the leadership of China, but for the party centre over the majority.
meaning: 列宁、斯大林论工会的用语：党联系群众的传动装置
current_zh: 这些机构都只是“传动带”
suggest: 传动带
note: 经典用语，保留

context: Finding out what has happened requires full-time specialized work for anyone not in the inner circle of leadership
meaning: 领导层的核心圈子
current_zh: 对于不在最高领导圈中的人来说
suggest: 领导核心圈子
note: 平实即可

en: After all the newspaper words and radio diatribes
context: After all the newspaper words and radio diatribes, still it was a “longstanding question”, even for party cadres!
meaning: 报纸写了那么多，电台激烈抨击了那么多
current_zh: 报纸连篇累牍，电台疾言厉色
suggest: 报纸连篇累牍，电台疾言厉色
note: 两个成语都贴切，保留；整句讽刺另见讽刺表

context: The few who did take Lenin’s criteria seriously, like Shengwulian and Li Yizhe, were hounded as “counter-revolutionaries”
meaning: 被当作反革命穷追不舍地迫害
current_zh: 都被当作“反革命”围剿
suggest: 都被打成“反革命”，遭到追剿
note: “打成反革命”是中文现成说法，场景在中国，可用；“围剿”多指军事

en: either the régime reconciled itself to defeat and destruction, or it had to introduce conscription
context: For example, too few men volunteered for the armed forces to fight the White armies; either the régime reconciled itself to defeat and destruction, or it had to introduce conscription.
meaning: 要么认命等着失败覆灭，要么实行征兵
current_zh: 这样一来，政权若不准备接受毁灭，就只能实行征兵制。
suggest: 政权要么坐以待毙，要么实行征兵
note: “坐以待毙”与 reconcile itself to defeat and destruction 完全对应，无中国特有典故；现译还漏了 defeat

en: None of the major changes of policy were discussed before they were implemented, and usually the government’s budget was ratified only long after it had come into effect.
context: None of the major changes of policy were discussed before they were implemented, and usually the government’s budget was ratified only long after it had come into effect.
meaning: 先办了再说，事后才拿来补个手续
current_zh: 没有任何重大政策变动会在实施之前加以讨论，政府预算也往往直到生效很久之后，才由这些机构追认。
suggest: 重大政策都是先斩后奏，政府预算往往生效很久才拿来追认
note: “先斩后奏”字面有斩杀画面、带古代色彩，场景在苏联，但它已是通用成语而非具体典故，可用；拿不准就保留现译；“先上车后补票”太俏皮

en: majority control ensured that the leadership had no alternative
context: Of course, in the original conception of democracy, it did not depend upon the leadership “practising” it: majority control ensured that the leadership had no alternative.
meaning: 多数人掌握控制权，领导不照办也不行
current_zh: 因为多数控制本身就会使领导层没有别的办法。
suggest: 多数人说了算，领导层不照办也得照办
note: “说了算”口语贴切，不改义

en: Nor does it mean the cadres do not get confused by the shifts and changes of policy.
context: Nor does it mean the cadres do not get confused by the shifts and changes of policy.
meaning: 政策变来变去，干部照样被弄糊涂
current_zh: 即便如此，它也不意味着干部们不会被政策摇摆弄糊涂。
suggest: 政策变来变去，干部照样被弄得晕头转向
note: “晕头转向”贴切 confused；不用“朝令夕改”，那多出“改得太频繁”的判断

en: all survived the Cultural Revolution intact
context: The key institutions of the Chinese State, its “armed bodies of men”, its police force, its bureaucracy with its privileges and secrets, all survived the Cultural Revolution intact.
meaning: 经过文革而丝毫未损
current_zh: 在文化大革命后都完整保留下来
suggest: 都安然度过文化大革命，毫发无损
note: “毫发无损”与 survived ... intact 对应；中性
